title: What Is a Fractional CMO, and When Do You Need One?
description: A fractional CMO is a senior marketing leader who works part time for several companies. Here is what one does, what it costs and when a startup should hire one.
coverAlt: Cover for the article What Is a Fractional CMO

faq.q: Is a fractional CMO the same as a consultant?
faq.a: No. A consultant advises, while a fractional CMO owns the marketing plan and the team that runs it.

faq.q: How long does a fractional CMO usually stay?
faq.a: Most engagements run for at least six months, because strategy needs time to show results.

faq.q: What does a fractional CMO cost?
faq.a: Fees depend on the hours and the scope. Ask each candidate for a written scope and a monthly fee before you compare them.

cta.heading: Need senior marketing leadership without a full-time hire?
cta.text: UNBOUND gives you a fractional CMO plus the team that executes the plan, on one retainer.
